sqlquery.from: ( select ccasecrmcasedetails_id, ccasecaseNumberString, ccasesubject, caseoriginname, casereasonname, typename, statusname, priorityname, assignee, resolver, receiveddate, updateddate, leadname, accname,contactname, oppname from ( select ccase.id ccasecrmcasedetails_id, max(ccase.caseNumberString) ccasecaseNumberString, max(ccase.subject) ccasesubject, max(caseorigin.name) caseoriginname, max(casereason.name) casereasonname, max(type.name) typename, max(status.name) statusname, max(priority.name) priorityname, max(coalesce(assignee.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(assignee.lastname,'')) assignee , max(coalesce(resolver.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(resolver.lastname,'')) resolver, max(ccase.creationDate) receiveddate, max(ccase.modificationDate) updateddate, max(coalesce(l.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(l.lastname,'')) leadname, max(acc.name) accname , max(coalesce(contact.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(contact.lastname,'')) contactname, max(opp.name) oppname from "$".crmcase ccase left join "$".crmcasedetails casedetails on casedetails.id = ccase.crmcasedetails_id left join "$".myuser assignee on ccase.owner = assignee.id left join "$".reference caseorigin on ccase.caseorigion = caseorigin.id left join "$".reference status on ccase.status = status.id left join "$".reference type on ccase.type = type.id left join "$".crmcontact l on ccase.lead_id = l.id left join "$".crmcontact contact on ccase.releatedto = contact.id left join "$".crmaccount acc on (ccase.crmaccount = acc.id or l.crmaccount=acc.id or contact.crmaccount=acc.id) left join "$".opportunity opp on ccase.opportunity = opp.id left join "$".reference priority on ccase.priority = priority.id left join "$".reference casereason on ccase.casereason = casereason.id left join "$".myuser resolver on ccase.resolver = resolver.id where ccase.deleted is not true and ccase.intrash is not true group by ccase.id ) cases ) t
